title: Arizona water evidence for defensible industrial growth
question: Which records show whether industrial growth has defensible water capacity?
why_it_matters: Industrial strategy in a water-constrained region depends on water rights, provider capacity, reuse, treatment, discharge, drought exposure, and public legitimacy.
current_support: FTFN has ADWR water governance, assured-supply criteria, the effective Phoenix AMA Fifth Management Plan, groundwater-site and national monitoring rails, Phoenix Water Services' April 2026 provider update, a May 2026 Phoenix-TSMC wastewater agreement, a City record showing TSMC Fab 3 at topping out, and a Project Baccara trail spanning planned chilled cooling and brewery-wastewater reuse, official county approval, and permit conditions.
missing_evidence: completed and accepted wastewater conveyance improvements
total facility water withdrawals and consumption
operating industrial reclaimed water plants and measured reuse
candidate_records: next City of Phoenix Water Resource Plan
executed TSMC wastewater development agreement and construction records
facility water balance, discharge, or measured reuse disclosure
Project Baccara service agreement, provider will-serve letter, water-system approvals, measured water balance, discharge, construction, and operating records
next_action: Track completion and acceptance of the TSMC conveyance improvements, operation of the first industrial reclaimed water plant by June 30, 2028, and Project Baccara's service, water-system, construction, and operating records; require measured facility water and reuse evidence before making sufficiency claims.

named_records: Phoenix City Council May 2026 TSMC Wastewater Facilities Development Agreement
City of Phoenix Civil Water And Sewer Acceptance Requirements
latest_review.stage_result: The official agreement still establishes authorized, customer-funded conveyance work and conditional wastewater acceptance for up to three fabs. The July 24 review did not surface a named certificate of completion, City acceptance, operating reclaimed-water plant, measured reuse result, or complete facility water balance.
latest_review.stop_rule: Do not create another agreement-stage signal. Reopen when Phoenix or TSMC posts a certificate of completion, acceptance, operating industrial reclaimed-water milestone, measured flow or reuse result, discharge record, or facility water balance.

notes: Phase 55Q records a dated hold because the named downstream stage did not advance. Phase 55S adds the Phoenix AMA Fifth Management Plan as an effective area-wide industrial conservation and compliance layer without treating it as project allocation or service evidence. Authorization, policy, and conditional flow capacity remain separate from constructed and accepted conveyance, operating reclaimed-water infrastructure, total demand, measured reuse, drought resilience, and long-term sufficiency.
